Our mutual energy? Self-cleaning tech that actually works. Sustainability that doesn't sacrifice style. No compromises ever.

Purify

Enhance water quality with 2-stage filtration and purification for cleaner, better-tasting water.

PureVis™ technology

Eliminates up to 99.999%* of Salmonella and 99.99%** of E. coli.

**Based on elimination 99.99% of E. coli in a 60-second cycle for all LARQ Bottles.

Nano Zero filtration

Improves taste and removes chlorine, pharmaceuticals and PFOA/PFOS.

Track

75% of people suffer from chronic dehydration. With LARQ Bottle PureVis™ 2 and the LARQ app, you can track your hydration habits and set goals to improve your hydration.

Track.

Set your goals to improve hydration.
Set and track goals to improve your hydration habits.

The LARQ App allows you to set personal hydration goals and keep track of your progress.

Internal sensors automatically measure the water levels inside your bottle every time you set it down, so you get real-time tracking.

Remind.

Customize reminders to elevate your hydration game.
Make LARQ your personal hydration coach.

Get reminders to drink more water where and when you want them. Let your bottle light up to remind you to drink up. It's that easy.

You can also turn on Do not disturb during quiet hours or if you just need a break from hydration coaching.

Insights.

Turn insights into action and stay on top of your goals.
Get the stats that matter.

Find some added motivation through insights. Do you want to set the longest streak? Or consistently reach your goals every day for 30 days?

Insights help you measure your performance, so you can always set a personal best.

Self-cleaning

Let's face it–bottles get dirty. PureVis™ technology activates every 2 hours to keep your bottle clean and stink-free.

Brilliantly clean

PureVis™ self-cleans in the background to keep your water and bottle clean. Or, push to start a PureVis™ cycle whenever you need it.

Chemical-free

Traditional UV-C technology uses toxic chemicals like Mercury to power the rays. PureVis™ uses mercury-free UV-C LED instead, a safer alternative to clean your water and bottle.

Prevents bio-contaminant growth

A water bottle is typically a breeding ground for bacteria, but self-cleaning PureVis™ technology ensures your water and bottle stay clean.

Bottle Filter Plan

A LARQ Bottle Filter lasts up to 2 months of use or about 25 gallons (94 liters) of water filtered—this equals to about 189 single-use bottles worth of filtered water.

Our hassle-free filter refill plan keeps you hydrated with brilliantly filtered water without skipping a beat.

If you subscribe, we'll send you replacement filter according to the refill frequency you select (shipping's on us!)*. You can always snooze or cancel your refill plan anytime.

Your card on file will be charged prior to shipment. Free shipping for filter renewals is available only for the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and EU.

Advanced Bottle Filter

Our innovative plant-based filters are independently tested to NSF/ANSI 42, 53, & 401 standards to be effective against a wide range of pollutants. Recommended for tap water with more known contaminants.
Not sure? Check out livelarq.com/water-quality for a list of known contaminants in your area (US only).

Due to the more robust contaminant removal, there is slightly higher resistance when drinking with the Advanced Bottle Filter—like drinking a milkshake or a smoothie.

  • Chlorine
  • PFAS (PFOA/PFOS)
  • Pharmaceuticals
  • Mercury
  • HAA5
  • Lead
  • Particulates
  • BPA

Guide

Refer to the guide for setup and care instructions.

How to use

Charge up

Plug in the USB-C charging cable included in the box to charge. This will unlock your new LARQ Bottle PureVis™ 2.

Download the LARQ App

Follow the pairing instructions in the app to set up your LARQ Bottle PureVis™ 2 and your hydration profile.

Prep the filter

Remove the filter from the filter pod and dispose of the outer packaging. Rinse the filter under running water for 30 seconds.

Activate PureVis™

Press once for Normal Mode (1-min cycle), double-click for Adventure Mode (3-min cycle). Enjoy pure water!
